concepts.def: Manipulates an independent variable to measure an effect.
Selecting a representative group from a population.
Consent, confidentiality and protection from harm.

walkthroughs.body_html: The IV is what you change, the DV is what you measure, and the EV is anything else that could affect the DV (e.g. noise, time of day). Good experiments operationalise all variables so they can be measured.
The null hypothesis predicts no difference (any difference is due to chance). The alternative hypothesis predicts a difference. A one-tailed hypothesis predicts direction; a two-tailed one does not.

Independent groups: different participants per condition. Repeated measures: same participants in both. Matched pairs: pairs matched on a key variable then split. Each has order-effect, individual-difference and feasibility trade-offs.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “DV”?
options: Statement predicting an effect or difference.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Alternative hypothesis”?
options: Statement predicting an effect or difference.
Statement predicting no effect or no difference.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Null hypothesis”?
options: Extraneous variable that could affect the DV.
Statement predicting no effect or no difference.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Operationalisation”?
options: Statement predicting no effect or no difference.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “IV”?
options: Statement predicting no effect or no difference.
Statement predicting an effect or difference.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “EV”?
options: Extraneous variable that could affect the DV.
Statement predicting an effect or difference.
